WITH prior_keys AS (SELECT gsis_id,season,week FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_release_20260919_morning.nfl_features__player_week_training` WHERE position IN ('QB','RB','WR','TE') AND (season<2026 OR (season=2026 AND week<2))),
refreshed_keys AS (SELECT gsis_id,season,week FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.player_week_training` WHERE position IN ('QB','RB','WR','TE') AND (season<2026 OR (season=2026 AND week<2))),
removed_keys AS (SELECT * FROM prior_keys EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT * FROM refreshed_keys),
added_keys AS (SELECT * FROM refreshed_keys EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT * FROM prior_keys)
SELECT 'removed' direction,season,week,COUNT(*) n_keys FROM removed_keys GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL SELECT 'added',season,week,COUNT(*) FROM added_keys GROUP BY 1,2,3
